shots.note: The car is parked in a front three-quarter view as a man holding a phone walks across its nose toward the driver's side; the circular front lamps change illumination, and the man's body successively occludes the car.
shots.why: 理想 i8 比原车大很多，需要重新匹配车身占位和人物遮挡，灯光也要按 i8 的实际造型呈现。

shots.note: Driver-eye highway view with the steering wheel and dashboard filling the foreground, the driver's right hand on the lower-right rim and left hand near the lap, and moving traffic visible through the windshield.
shots.why: 用户图没有座舱，方向盘、仪表台和屏幕位置需要内饰素材才能准确还原。

shots.note: The moving car is tracked from a low front three-quarter angle into a nearly straight-on front view, with rotating wheels, the driver visible behind the windshield, and highway barriers passing behind.
shots.why: 可以保留原来的行驶和跟拍方式，但用户图未展示车头，且两车体型差别明显。

shots.note: A wider parallel tracking view shows the moving car from its front quarter and side, with its full body and spinning wheels visible against the sunlit highway.
shots.why: 侧面有参考，但更长更大的 i8 需要重新匹配画面中的位置、透视和轮胎运动。

shots.note: The car is stationary in a close front three-quarter view beside yellow road markings while a foreground hand presents and points toward its front lamps; another vehicle remains parked immediately behind it.
shots.why: 需要补足 i8 车头细节，并让前景手指与更大的车身正确遮挡，后方车辆保持原样。

shots.note: The camera looks through the open driver's doorway and moves across the steering wheel, dashboard, center touchscreen, front seat, and console; the screen displays a static media page without a demonstrated touch sequence.
shots.why: 这是完整的前排内饰展示，仅凭外观照片无法确定座椅、方向盘和中控的真实样子。

shots.note: Driver-eye highway view with both hands holding the lower steering-wheel rim, slight steering movement, the instrument display and center screen visible, and lane markings shifting as the vehicle changes position.
shots.why: 行驶和握方向盘的动作可以保留，但需要 i8 内饰参考来匹配方向盘、手部接触和屏幕位置。

shots.note: The highway cockpit view continues with both hands on the wheel, subtle steering corrections, moving vehicles ahead, and a changing center-screen display without visible menu interaction.
shots.why: 可以复刻驾驶画面，但用户图没有内饰，屏幕内容和方向盘细节需要真实参考。

shots.note: The car travels beside tall highway sound barriers as the tracking view shifts from a close front quarter to a centered front view and then a more distant frontal view, with visible changes in front-lamp brightness.
shots.why: 行驶、远近变化和跟拍都能保留，但车头与灯组要按 i8 实物重做，不能沿用原车圆灯。

shots.note: The moving car approaches from a wider front three-quarter view, grows large beside the tracking camera, and transitions toward a side view, with spinning wheels and strong moving reflections along its body.
shots.why: 用户图能支持侧面外观，但近距离车头和更大的车身比例仍需补充参考并重新匹配。
